themeCustomization.userIntent: 提升整体 UI 设计感，向苹果风格靠拢：更大的圆弧、磨砂玻璃质感、更柔和的多层阴影

softWarnings: [html-quality] colors_and_type.css: oversized radius tokens (user explicitly requested Apple-style large rounded shapes)
[html-quality] colors_and_type.css: deeper shadow alphas for premium elevated cards (user explicitly requested Apple-style premium feel)

intentProfile.routingReason: Theme customization: elevate overall UI premium feel across all existing pages by increasing border radius, refining shadow scale, and applying frosted-glass surfaces while preserving the shared Taichu skeleton and three skin signatures.

continuityAnchors: Midnight ink + champagne gold + ivory paper base
Cormorant Garamond / Noto Serif SC display + Noto Sans SC body
Hairline gold borders and soft card shadow
Three skin signatures: guoxue jade/cinnabar, xishi amethyst/amber, psych warm apricot/misty blue

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: Midnight ink (#1A2138) + champagne gold (#B8893E) + ivory paper (#F7F4EC); skin signature colors jade/cinnabar for guoxue, deep blue/silver for astrology, amber/amethyst for tarot
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Card radius 16px, button 12px, pill 999px; 8px spacing grid; hairline gold dividers
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Cormorant Garamond serif for display/headings, Noto Sans SC for body; 8px type scale 11-32px
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: Ivory cards floating on cosmic field; gold hairline borders; skin-accent buttons; star-orbit progress; seal disclaimer
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Single-layer soft shadow 0 2px 12px rgba(26,33,56,.10); flat elevated cards on deep field
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Star-orbit motifs, constellation hairlines, zodiac/tarot symbols; psych test adds Notion-style line-drawn avatars; Taichu seal logo and brand pattern unify all pages
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Subtle scale hover, opacity breathing stars, prefers-reduced-motion respect

creativeRecipe.businessTone: Mystic-luxury H5 for career-life guidance, warm and authoritative rather than tech-cold or fortune-teller tacky
creativeRecipe.layoutArchetype: Mobile-first single-column cards with cosmic field accents and generous negative space
creativeRecipe.visualSignature: Midnight blue + champagne gold + ivory paper base; each skin adds one cultural signature hue and motif; Taichu seal/logo unifies every page
creativeRecipe.avoidOneThing: Avoid turning three themes into three different apps; keep shared skeleton visible
